chunks.chunk_text: HIGH COURT OF DELHI : NEW DELHI WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 4589 OF 2024 ORDER DATED 14.10.2024: 1. Heard learned senior counsel for the petitioner and standing counsel for the respondent authority.
2. The statutory penalty of Rs. 25,000/- imposed under Section 19(8)(b) is hereby affirmed. 3. The petitioner shall deposit the said cost in the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund within 4 weeks.
4. In the event of default, interest at the rate of 9% per annum shall be leviable.
